name: Deficiency Non-Response Multi-Tier Escalation
description: Multi-tier escalation policy triggered when an applicant institution fails to submit rectified documents within the 7-day cure window.
aphClauseCitation: APH Chapter I Cl. 1.7 & Chapter II Cl. 2.19

tiers.description: Level 1: 2 days overdue. System marks case as DELINQUENT and dispatches formal warning notice to Institution Chairman and Regional Officer.
Level 2: 5 days overdue. Automatic referral to Standing Hearing Committee (SHC) for default adverse determination.
tiers.actionRequired: Docket case on SHC hearing roster.

autoResolutionCondition: Institution submits complete rectification package or case transitions to HEARING_OR_COMMITTEE_REVIEW.
